转换后必查三件事

import anndata as ad
adata = ad.read_h5ad("output.h5ad")

# 1. 空间坐标在不在，单位是什么（像素 vs 微米，差 1000 倍）
print(adata.obsm["spatial"][:3])

# 2. 坐标是 (x, y) 还是 (row, col)？画出来方向对不对
#    很多转换脚本不统一，方向反了图会上下颠倒
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
plt.scatter(*adata.obsm["spatial"].T, s=1); plt.gca().invert_yaxis(); plt.show()

# 3. 图像与坐标能对上吗（scalefactors 是否一起搬过来了）
print(adata.uns.get("spatial"))

gef_to_anndata.py python · 1528 bytes 
"""
Stereo-seq GEF → AnnData 转换脚本
===================================
用法：python gef_to_anndata.py --gef /path/to/cellbin.gef --output output.h5ad
"""
import argparse
import stereo as st


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="Convert Stereo-seq GEF to AnnData")
    parser.add_argument("--gef", required=True, help="Path to GEF file")
    parser.add_argument("--bin-type", default="cell_bins",
                        choices=["cell_bins", "bins"], help="Bin type")
    parser.add_argument("--bin-size", type=int, default=None,
                        help="Bin size (for bin_type='bins')")
    parser.add_argument("--flavor", default="scanpy",
                        choices=["scanpy", "seurat"], help="AnnData flavor")
    parser.add_argument("--output", default="output.h5ad",
                        help="Output h5ad file path")
    args = parser.parse_args()

    # 读取 GEF
    read_kwargs = {
        "file_path": args.gef,
        "is_sparse": True,
        "bin_type": args.bin_type,
    }
    if args.bin_size is not None:
        read_kwargs["bin_size"] = args.bin_size

    data = st.io.read_gef(**read_kwargs)
    print(f"Loaded: {data}")

    # QC
    print("Running QC...")
    data.tl.cal_qc()

    # 转为 AnnData
    print(f"Converting to AnnData ({args.flavor} flavor)...")
    adata = st.io.stereo_to_anndata(data, flavor=args.flavor, output=args.output)
    print(f"Saved to {args.output}")
    print(f"AnnData: {adata}")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

run_spaceranger.sh bash · 1006 bytes 
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# ============================================
# 10x Visium 上游定量 (Space Ranger)
# ============================================
set -euo pipefail

# ---------- 配置参数（请根据实际情况修改）----------
PROJECT_DIR="/path/to/project"
SPACERANGER="/path/to/spaceranger-4.0.1"
TRANSCRIPTOME="/path/to/refdata-gex-mm10-2020-A"
FASTQS_DIR="/path/to/fastqs"
PROBE_SET="/path/to/probe_set.csv"
IMAGE_TIF="/path/to/tissue_image.tif"
SLIDE_ID="H1-8CPZTMY"
AREA="A1"
SAMPLE_ID="Spatial_Sample"
CORES=30
MEM_GB=300
# -------------------------------------------------

export PATH="${SPACERANGER}:${PATH}"

mkdir -p "${PROJECT_DIR}/runs"
cd "${PROJECT_DIR}/runs"

spaceranger count \
    --id="${SAMPLE_ID}" \
    --transcriptome="${TRANSCRIPTOME}" \
    --fastqs="${FASTQS_DIR}" \
    --probe-set="${PROBE_SET}" \
    --image="${IMAGE_TIF}" \
    --slide="${SLIDE_ID}" \
    --area="${AREA}" \
    --create-bam=false \
    --localcores="${CORES}" \
    --localmem="${MEM_GB}"
